about_the_game:
Embark on a strategic adventure where during the day you'll build and optimize your fortress, while at night you must defend it against relentless waves of enemies. Plan cunningly and execute the perfect strategy to achieve your objectives.

Economy Management

Carefully manage your gold coins to maintain the ideal balance between resource accumulation and fortifying your defenses, essential for your survival.

Diverse Constructions

Build and upgrade over 15 types of structures, each designed with specific functions that provide you with unique strategic advantages as you enhance them.

Varied Enemies

Face more than 15 classes of adversaries, each with distinct statistics and exclusive mechanics that will put your tactical skills to the test in every battle.

Random Events

Experience the thrill of over 20 random events—both beneficial and challenging—that trigger with each wave, keeping the gameplay fresh and full of surprises.

Character Customization

Choose from a wide variety of weapons, each with unique attributes, and select the mount that best complements your playstyle to craft lethal, personalized strategies.

Dynamic Gameplay

Confront increasingly challenging waves of monsters as you progress, ensuring a nonstop, action-packed, and exhilarating experience.

short_description: Simple strategy game in which you must build and expand your kingdom while defending it from waves of enemies. You will be able to recruit allies and raise defenses, while adversaries become more numerous and evolve over time.
